title: Pablo Ice Cold Nicotine Pouches - 24mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Ice Cold Nicotine Pouches deliver an ultra-intense Mint and Menthol kick in a discreet, smoke-free format. Designed for experienced users, each slim pouch contains a powerful 24mg nicotine dose, making it one of the strongest nicotine pouch options available. Despite their strength, Pablo pouches are entirely tobacco-free and crafted for comfort. Simply place a pouch between your gum and upper lip to enjoy a clean, fast-acting nicotine experience without vapour, smoke, or lingering odour. These slim pouches fit discreetly under the lip and begin releasing nicotine in just seconds. Pablo pouches are designed for those who prefer high-strength satisfaction in a modern, no-fuss format. With their icy mint profile and strong delivery, Ice Cold offers a potent way to manage cravings on the go. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 24mg of nicotine per pouch.
